classification: SYNTHETIC - conformance fixtures, not production evidence

pinned_implementation.name: agent-passport-system
pinned_implementation.note: All cases MUST be evaluated with agent-passport-system 8.0.1 implementing draft-pidlisnyi-aps-04 sections 4.1-4.3. Results from any other build are out of scope for this conformance set.

implementation_boundary.summary: The APS chain verifier (draft-pidlisnyi-aps-04 sections 4.1-4.3) does NOT inspect the DID document directly. It requires a caller-supplied resolver to check the issuer's key at issued_at.
aps_verifier_does: Resolve the issuer's key through a caller-supplied resolver at the delegation's issued_at (sections 4.1-4.2).
Verify the delegation signature and the delegation digest / chain linkage (section 4.3).
aps_verifier_does_not: Fetch or parse the DID document.
Resolve a did:webvh DID log or read its time windows.
Check the verification relationship (assertionMethod / keyAgreement / capabilityDelegation) of the key.
implementation_boundary.consequence: Checks outside the APS boundary MUST be reported as "not_exercised", never as a pass. A case whose target check is outside the boundary is a spec-level vector: it is not exercised by agent-passport-system 8.0.1 and MUST NOT be counted as a passing conformance result.

harness_contract.description: Each case supplies a DID log (a list of did:webvh log entries) and an APS delegation. A full NTI verifier MUST resolve the DID as of signed_at, resolve the ML-DSA-87 verification method, apply the verification relationship, and decide. The pinned APS implementation exercises only the sub-checks inside its boundary (see implementation_boundary).

aps_required_resolver.note: APS does not build this resolver. If the caller does not supply one, the issuer-key-at-issued_at check cannot run and MUST be reported as "not_exercised".

resolver_scope.issued_at: the APS resolver checks the ISSUER key at issued_at (draft-pidlisnyi-aps-04 sections 4.1-4.3).
resolver_scope.signed_at: signing-time validity of the AGENT key at signed_at is NOT part of the APS boundary; a full NTI verifier performs it separately (docs/NTI-Agent-DID-INTEROP.md section 2.1).

did_log_entry_fields.valid_from: RFC 3339 UTC; the entry is active from this instant
did_log_entry_fields.valid_until: RFC 3339 UTC or null; the entry is active until this instant (exclusive). null means still active.
did_log_entry_fields.capabilityDelegation: list of verification method ids (zcap-style capability delegation; never a receipt-signing relationship)
did_log_entry_fields.deactivated: true if this entry deactivates the DID

expected_fields.reason_code: one of the machine-readable codes below
expected_fields.checks: which layers were exercised. Each value is one of: pass | fail | not_exercised. See docs/NTI-Agent-DID-INTEROP.md section 2.

check_status_values.pass: the pinned implementation performed the check and it succeeded.
check_status_values.fail: the pinned implementation performed the check and it failed.
check_status_values.not_exercised: the pinned implementation does not perform this check (outside the APS boundary). This is NOT a pass and MUST NOT be counted as one.

cases.title: Valid key
cases.description: Baseline positive case. The ML-DSA-87 key is active at signed_at, listed under assertionMethod, not revoked, and the delegation digest matches the signed root.

expected.rationale: APS resolves the issuer key at issued_at (pass) and verifies the delegation digest (pass). The DID-document authorization check is outside the APS boundary and is reported not_exercised.

cases.title: Key rotated out before signing time
cases.description: The ML-DSA-87 key #ml-dsa-87-1 was retired in log version 2 (valid_until 2026-11-06T12:00:00Z) and replaced by #ml-dsa-87-2. The receipt was signed at 14:17:02Z with the OLD key. A full verifier MUST evaluate the DID log as of signed_at and reject. The APS chain verifier does not inspect the DID document, so it cannot exercise this check.

expected.rationale: At signed_at (14:17:02Z) the active entry is version 2, which no longer authorises #ml-dsa-87-1; the key had been rotated out at 12:00:00Z. This is the required spec-level decision, but the APS chain verifier does not read the DID log, so no APS check is exercised here.

cases.title: Deactivated DID
cases.description: The DID log's latest entry is marked deactivated=true at 2026-11-06T13:00:00Z, before signed_at. A DID deactivation is terminal: no key may sign after it. The APS chain verifier does not inspect the DID document, so it cannot exercise this check.

expected.rationale: The DID was deactivated at 13:00:00Z, before signed_at; deactivation is terminal and precedes key-level checks. The APS chain verifier does not read the DID log, so this check is not exercised by the pinned implementation.

cases.title: Key listed only under keyAgreement
cases.description: The ML-DSA-87 key #ml-dsa-87-1 is present and active at signed_at, but it is listed only under keyAgreement (a key-agreement relationship), not under assertionMethod. A key in keyAgreement MUST NOT be used to verify signatures. The APS chain verifier does not inspect the DID document, so it cannot exercise this check.

expected.rationale: The key is active and unrevoked but appears only under keyAgreement. Per docs/NTI-Agent-DID-INTEROP.md section 2.1, only assertionMethod keys may verify receipts. The APS chain verifier does not inspect verification relationships, so this check is not exercised by the pinned implementation.

cases.title: Delegation modified after signing
cases.description: The key is fully valid (as in case 1), but the delegation scope was modified after signing: the `actions` array gained `ledger.admin`. The delegation now hashes to the tampered root, which does not match the signed delegation_chain_root. The ML-DSA-87 signature over the original payload no longer covers these bytes.

mutations.note: privilege escalation added after the signature was produced

expected.rationale: The recomputed delegation digest (5e2583...) does not equal the signed delegation_chain_root (fdc448...). APS verifies the delegation digest, so this check is exercised and fails.

cases.title: Key listed only under capabilityDelegation
cases.description: The ML-DSA-87 key #ml-dsa-87-1 is present and active at signed_at, but it is listed only under capabilityDelegation (an object-capability delegation relationship), not under assertionMethod. A key in capabilityDelegation MUST NOT be used to verify receipt signatures. Requested by Tymofii (APS creator).

expected.rationale: The key is active and unrevoked but appears only under capabilityDelegation. capabilityDelegation is an object-capability relationship, not a signing relationship; only assertionMethod keys may verify receipts. The APS chain verifier does not inspect verification relationships, so this check is not exercised by the pinned implementation.

cases.title: Key listed only under assertionMethod
cases.description: The ML-DSA-87 key #ml-dsa-87-1 is present and active at signed_at and is listed under assertionMethod (and nowhere else). This is the relationship a receipt-signing key must use, so the receipt is accepted. Requested by Tymofii (APS creator).

expected.rationale: The key is listed only under assertionMethod, the only relationship valid for receipt signing, and the delegation digest matches. The relationship check itself is a DID-document check outside the APS boundary and is reported not_exercised; the APS resolver and digest checks pass.

aps_exercised.note: 5 of 7 cases target DID-document checks the pinned APS implementation does not perform. Report them as not_exercised; do not count them as passes.
